films.title: Monster Pets: A Hotel Transylvania Short
films.overview: Drac tries out some new monster pets to help occupy Tinkles for playtime.

films.title: Minions & More Volume 1
films.overview: This collection of 10 short films produced by Illumination includes: From the "Despicable Me" franchise: Puppy (2013); Minion Scouts (2019); Training Wheels (2013); The Secret Life of Kyle (2017); Santa's Little Helpers (2019).  From the "Grinch" franchise: The Dog Days of Winter (2019).  From the "Secret Life of Pets" franchise: Norman Television (2016); Weenie (2016).  From the "Sing" franchise: Love at First Sight (2017).  From the "Lorax" franchise: Forces of Nature (2012).

films.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
films.overview: Desperate to be a big guy, SpongeBob sets out to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs by following The Flying Dutchman – a mysterious swashbuckling ghost pirate – on a seafaring adventure that takes him to the deepest depths of the deep sea, where no Sponge has gone before.

films.title: Santa's Little Helpers
films.overview: After being accidentally stranded at the North Pole, the Minions decide to embrace their new surroundings by taking on the role of Santa's helpers. Chaos and hilarity ensue as they attempt to prove their worth as elves, bringing their signature mischief to the workshop in this festive, lighthearted holiday adventure.

films.title: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
films.overview: When Van Helsing's mysterious invention, the "Monsterfication Ray," goes haywire, Drac and his monster pals are all transformed into humans, and Johnny becomes a monster. In their new mismatched bodies, Drac and Johnny must team up and race across the globe to find a cure before it's too late, and before they drive each other crazy.
